sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by immunostaining without membrane permeabilization (FLAG detected extracellularly); photoreceptor function of OPN5-HEK cells was the subject of the study but the ledger clip does not report a direct functional assay result for the tagged construct vs. untagged.
sites.rationale: OPN5 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place EC1 (residues 1–33) as the sole extracellular N-terminal region. The paper (PMC12814955) reports a FLAG tag displayed on the outside of the cell via a snorkel structure in a full-length, membrane-anchored OPN5 construct, confirmed by non-permeabilized immunostaining. No specific residue or junction is named in either L1 or L2, so the position is topology-derived to the EC1 region rather than a pinned junction. The snorkel language indicates an engineered extracellular display construct rather than a simple prepend, so insert_after_residue is left null and the region is recorded as EC1. Full-length OPN5 expressed in HEK293T cells with a FLAG tag engineered onto the extracellular face via a described 'snorkel structure'; the construct is membrane-anchored and full-length.

literature_notes: L1 and L2 both ground the same FLAG-snorkel site; L1 is cited as the primary supporting clip. L3 (PMC12457702), L4 (PMC10432815), L5 (PMC8766551), and L6 (PMC12405127) all report rho1D4 (ETSQVAPA) appended to the C-terminus of OPN5 or close orthologs; the C-terminus falls in IC4 (residues 310–354), which is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so these are recorded in other_positions rather than sites. No ledger line names a specific extracellular residue or junction for any insertion, so no 'validated' or pinned-residue site can be reported. The snorkel site is the only extracellular tag supported by the ledger.
